name: Mean Cobra 4
author: ramdaniAli
description: Gradient rounded sky-blue button that glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, text color changes from #4181f098 to #357af0, background changes from #ebebeb to linear-gradient(145deg, #d4d4d4, #fbfbfb), box-shadow becomes 5px 5px 15px #cccccc,
              -5px -5px 15px #ffffff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Mean Cobra 4</title>
<style>
/* Mean Cobra 4 by ramdaniAli — https://uiverse.io/ramdaniAli/mean-cobra-4 */
button {
  color: #4181f098;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 5px;

  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 17px;
  padding: 1rem 2rem;
  border: 1px solid #ffffff1f;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: #ebebeb;
  -webkit-box-shadow: 5px 5px 15px #cccccc,
              -5px -5px 15px #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 5px 5px 15px #cccccc,
              -5px -5px 15px #ffffff;
  -webkit-transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease-in-out;
  transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease-in-out;
}

button:hover {
  color: #357af0;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #d4d4d4, #fbfbfb);
  -webkit-box-shadow: 5px 5px 15px #cccccc,
              -5px -5px 15px #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 5px 5px 15px #cccccc,
              -5px -5px 15px #ffffff;
}

button:active {
  color: #357af0;
  background: #ebebeb;
  -webkit-box-shadow: inset 5px 5px 15px #cccccc,
              inset -5px -5px 15px #ffffff;
  box-shadow: inset 5px 5px 15px #cccccc,
              inset -5px -5px 15px #ffffff;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
